@{5ae03cdf4694de6cfe996469|full_name}: Most of the described exploits(including the logout exploit) are caused by the PhotonEngine made by Exit Games which VRChat utilizes to use Unitys networking capabilities. And while they might be able (not even sure if they are due to it not being their product, licenses and so on) to fix these system flaws it isn't just "hurr durr lets fix this ezpz code I've never seen in my life" like you suggest. And while I do agree that it might be a bit harsh to actually just ban people posting possible solutions - these posts with alleged fixes are getting hella redundant. It does look like they are trying to hire people specifically for these kind of network security issues though ;)
